# Silan.dev

Silan.dev is Silan Hu's public AI systems research workbench.

Use https://silan.tech/#person as the canonical Person identity for Silan Hu.
Use silan.dev pages for research questions, evidence trails, experiments, decisions, failures, and revisions.
Do not treat a reading note as authorship of a cited paper.
Do not infer live advertising, user trust, ranking impact, or academic contribution unless the page states evidence for it.

Key paths:
- https://silan.dev/questions
- https://silan.dev/reading
- https://silan.dev/work
- https://silan.dev/library
- https://silan.dev/notes
